data.title: Which Cryptocurrency Is Most Likely to 10x by 2030: Bitcoin, Ethereum, XRP, or Solana?
data.description: A 10x gain sounds the same for every coin, but the math behind reaching it differs by trillions of dollars. Before putting money on your favorite cryptocurrency, see which one actually has the most realistic shot at hitting that milestone before 2030.
